notes: הִרְבּוּ → *gave in abundance* is headed on *abundance*, which carries רבה; *gave* is the light verb (rule 44), and heading on *gave* was the competing reading.
לָרֹב fuses to *abundantly* under rule 30, headed on the noun.
In מַעְשַׂר הַכֹּל the rectum is rendered anarthrously (*of all things*), so the article takes the phrase's single fronted *the* (rule 29).
